-- SnowFieldService: PERSONAL fields with tile HP.
-- Each tile has a phase (0-3 layers left) and HP for its top layer.
-- Every shovel arm that sweeps over a tile deals its Power as damage; at 0 HP the layer breaks and pays out.
-- Updates are sent only to the owning player as triples: index, phase, hpPercent.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local DataService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("DataService"))
local SF = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields"))
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local Balance = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Balance"))
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldUpdate")
local syncFunc = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFieldSync")
local collectedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowCollected")

local TICK = 0.2
local TS = SF.TileSize
local SPEED = SF.Spinner.Speed
local R_IN, R_OUT = SF.Spinner.Inner, SF.Spinner.Outer
local TWO_PI = math.pi * 2
local MAX = SF.MaxPhase

local defs = {}
for _, f in ipairs(SF.Fields) do
	defs[f.Id] = {def = f, origin = SF.Origin(f), maxHP = math.max(1, f.TileHP or 1)}
end

-- states[player][fieldId] = {phases = {}, hp = {}, pending = {}}
local states = {}
local function getStates(player)
	local st = states[player]
	if not st then
		st = {}
		for id, d in pairs(defs) do
			local n = d.def.Width * d.def.Depth
			st[id] = {phases = table.create(n, MAX), hp = table.create(n, d.maxHP), pending = {}}
		end
		states[player] = st
	end
	return st
end

local lastTime = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	states[p] = nil
	lastTime[p] = nil
end)

local function pct(hp, maxHP) return math.clamp(math.floor(hp / maxHP * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100) end

syncFunc.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local out = {}
	for id, s in pairs(getStates(player)) do
		local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
		local hp = table.create(#s.hp, 100)
		for i, v in ipairs(s.hp) do hp[i] = pct(v, maxHP) end
		out[id] = {p = table.concat(s.phases), h = hp}
	end
	return out
end

local function flush(player, st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		if next(s.pending) then
			local maxHP = defs[id].maxHP
			local flat = {}
			for i in pairs(s.pending) do
				flat[#flat + 1] = i
				flat[#flat + 1] = s.phases[i]
				flat[#flat + 1] = pct(s.hp[i], maxHP)
			end
			s.pending = {}
			updateEvent:FireClient(player, id, flat)
		end
	end
end

-- damage per arm, from each equipped shovel's Power
local function armPowers(player)
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels")
	local list = {}
	if not attr or attr == "" then return list end
	for name in attr:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local item = Config.ByName[name]
		table.insert(list, item and (item.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(item.Chance)) or 1)
	end
	return list
end

local function collect(player, st, now)
	local prev = lastTime[player]
	lastTime[player] = now
	if not prev then return end
	local powers = armPowers(player)
	local spd = SPEED * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1)
	local rOut = R_OUT * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1) * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1)
	local bonus = player:GetAttribute("PowerBonus") or 0
	local pmult = player:GetAttribute("PowerMult") or 1
	local n = #powers
	if n == 0 then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

	local sweep = math.min((now - prev) * spd, TWO_PI)
	local pos = root.Position
	local gained = 0

	for id, d in pairs(defs) do
		local f, origin, maxHP = d.def, d.origin, d.maxHP
		if f.Style and f.Style ~= "Starter" and player:GetAttribute("Stage_" .. f.Style) ~= true then continue end -- stage locked
		local lx, lz = pos.X - origin.X, pos.Z - origin.Z
		if lx > -rOut and lz > -rOut and lx < f.Width * TS + rOut and lz < f.Depth * TS + rOut
			and math.abs(pos.Y - origin.Y) < 9 then
			local s = st[id]
			local x0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lx - rOut) / TS))
			local x1 = math.min(f.Width - 1, math.floor((lx + rOut) / TS))
			local z0 = math.max(0, math.floor((lz - rOut) / TS))
			local z1 = math.min(f.Depth - 1, math.floor((lz + rOut) / TS))
			for k = 0, n - 1 do
				local dmg = (powers[k + 1] + bonus) * pmult
				local a0 = prev * spd + k * (TWO_PI / n) + (player.UserId % 7)
				for x = x0, x1 do
					for z = z0, z1 do
						local i = z * f.Width + x + 1
						if s.phases[i] > 0 then
							local dx = origin.X + (x + 0.5) * TS - pos.X
							local dz = origin.Z + (z + 0.5) * TS - pos.Z
							local d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz
							if d2 >= R_IN * R_IN and d2 <= rOut * rOut
								and (math.atan2(dz, dx) - a0) % TWO_PI <= sweep then
								local hp = s.hp[i] - dmg
								local p = s.phases[i]
								-- strong shovels can break several layers in one hit
								while hp <= 0 and p > 0 do
									p -= 1
									gained += f.SnowPerPhase
									hp += maxHP
								end
								if p == 0 then hp = maxHP end
								s.phases[i] = p
								s.hp[i] = hp
								s.pending[i] = true
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if gained > 0 then
		-- equipped pets boost the snow you earn
		local pets = {}
		for n in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(pets, n) end
		gained = math.max(1, math.floor(gained * (1 + (PetConfig.Multiplier(pets) - 1) * (player:GetAttribute("PetBoostMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("SnowMult") or 1) + 0.5))
		DataService.AddSnow(player, gained)
		collectedEvent:FireClient(player, gained)
	end
end

local function regrow(st)
	for id, s in pairs(st) do
		local d = defs[id]
		local chance = 1 / d.def.RegrowSeconds
		for i, p in ipairs(s.phases) do
			if p < MAX and math.random() < chance then
				s.phases[i] = p + 1
				s.hp[i] = d.maxHP
				s.pending[i] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

local acc, regrowAcc = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	acc += dt
	regrowAcc += dt
	if acc < TICK then return end
	acc = 0
	local doRegrow = regrowAcc >= 1
	if doRegrow then regrowAcc = 0 end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local st = getStates(player)
		collect(player, st, now)
		if doRegrow then regrow(st) end
		flush(player, st)
	end
end)

-- PetFollow: every player's equipped pets hop along behind them (built & animated locally).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PetModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetModels"))

local BEHIND = 7.5        -- distance behind the player (outside the shovel spinner)
local SPACING = 3.4       -- side-by-side spacing
local VIEW_DISTANCE = 200

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "FollowingPets"
folder.Parent = workspace

local rigs = {}
local function clear(player)
	local r = rigs[player]
	if r then for _, p in ipairs(r) do p.model:Destroy() end end
	rigs[player] = nil
end
local function build(player)
	clear(player)
	local r = {}
	for name in (player:GetAttribute("EquippedPets") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local m = PetModels.create(name)
		local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
		m.Parent = folder
		table.insert(r, {model = m, half = size.Y / 2, cf = nil})
	end
	rigs[player] = r
end
local function track(player)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedPets"):Connect(function() build(player) end)
	build(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(track, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clear)

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	local camPos = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	for player, r in pairs(rigs) do
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local visible = hrp and (hrp.Position - camPos).Magnitude < VIEW_DISTANCE
		local moving = hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
		local n = #r
		for i, p in ipairs(r) do
			if not visible then
				p.model.Parent = nil
				p.cf = nil
			else
				if p.model.Parent ~= folder then p.model.Parent = folder end
				local look = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
				local right = Vector3.new(-look.Z, 0, look.X)
				local side = (i - (n + 1) / 2) * SPACING
				local target = hrp.Position - look * (BEHIND + math.abs(side) * 0.3) + right * side
				-- stand on the ground
				params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, folder}
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(target + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), Vector3.new(0, -14, 0), params)
				local groundY = hit and hit.Position.Y or (hrp.Position.Y - 3)
				local hop = moving and math.abs(math.sin(t * 9 + i)) * 0.9 or math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 0.15
				local pos = Vector3.new(target.X, groundY + p.half + hop, target.Z)
				local goal = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look)
				p.cf = p.cf and p.cf:Lerp(goal, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 10)) or goal
				p.model:PivotTo(p.cf)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- ShovelOrbit: renders every player's equipped shovels orbiting around them.
-- Which shovels a player has comes from the server (player attribute "EquippedShovels").
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local templates = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ShovelModels")
local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Spinner = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SnowFields")).Spinner

-- hide Roblox's default hotbar / backpack
task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		if pcall(function() StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false) end) then break end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end)

local INNER = 1.6        -- gap between the player's center and the shovel grips (the "hub")
local HEIGHT = -0.2      -- height of the spinner relative to the player's center (waist)
local SPEED = Spinner.Speed -- spin speed (radians / second), shared with the server's scraping
local SCALE = 0.8        -- size of the shovels
local TILT = 8           -- degrees the arms tilt up at the tips (0 = perfectly flat)
local GRIP_FROM_PIVOT = 1.8 * SCALE   -- distance from the shovel's pivot (shaft middle) to the top of its grip
local VIEW_DISTANCE = 220

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "OrbitingShovels"
folder.Parent = workspace

local rigs = {} -- [player] = {shovels = {{model=, shown=}}}

local function clear(player)
	local r = rigs[player]
	if r then
		for _, s in ipairs(r.shovels) do s.model:Destroy() end
	end
	rigs[player] = nil
end

local function build(player)
	clear(player)
	local attr = player:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""
	local r = {shovels = {}}
	for name in attr:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local t = templates:FindFirstChild(name) or templates:FindFirstChild("_Placeholder") -- placeholder until it has its own 3D model
		if t then
			local m = t:Clone()
			m:ScaleTo(SCALE * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1))
			-- outlines only on your own shovels (Roblox limits how many outlines can show)
			if player ~= localPlayer then
				local h = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight")
				if h then h:Destroy() end
			end
			m.Parent = folder
			table.insert(r.shovels, {model = m, shown = true})
		end
	end
	rigs[player] = r
end

local function track(player)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedShovels"):Connect(function() build(player) end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SizeMult"):Connect(function() build(player) end)
	build(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(track, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clear)

local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local camPos = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
	for player, r in pairs(rigs) do
		local char = player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local visible = root ~= nil and (root.Position - camPos).Magnitude < VIEW_DISTANCE
		local n = #r.shovels
		for i, s in ipairs(r.shovels) do
			if not visible then
				if s.shown then s.model.Parent = nil; s.shown = false end
			else
				if not s.shown then s.model.Parent = folder; s.shown = true end
				-- fidget spinner: every shovel is a spoke, grip toward the player, blade pointing out
				local ang = now * SPEED * (player:GetAttribute("SpinMult") or 1) + (i - 1) * (2 * math.pi / n) + (player.UserId % 7)
				local out = Vector3.new(math.cos(ang), math.sin(math.rad(TILT)), math.sin(ang)).Unit
				local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				local yAxis = -out                       -- shovel's +Y (grip) points at the hub
				local xAxis = yAxis:Cross(up).Unit       -- sideways, so the blade lies flat
				local zAxis = xAxis:Cross(yAxis)         -- blade face points up
				local center = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, HEIGHT, 0)
				local pos = center + out * (INNER + GRIP_FROM_PIVOT * (player:GetAttribute("SizeMult") or 1)) * (player:GetAttribute("ReachMult") or 1)
				s.model:PivotTo(CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, xAxis, yAxis, zAxis))
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- RollController: vertical reel, full / minimized modes, auto-roll.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local ItemIcon = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ItemIcon"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RollRNG")
local Cutscene = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("RareDropCutscene"))

local gui = script.Parent
local stage = gui:WaitForChild("RollStage")
local aspect = stage:WaitForChild("Aspect")
local slotsFrame = stage:WaitForChild("Slots")
local glow = stage:WaitForChild("Glow")
local glowScale = glow:WaitForChild("UIScale")
local rays = stage:WaitForChild("Rays")
local pointerL, pointerR = stage:WaitForChild("PointerL"), stage:WaitForChild("PointerR")
local dim = gui:WaitForChild("RollDim")
local rollFinished = gui:WaitForChild("RollFinished")
local bottom = gui:WaitForChild("BottomBar")
local rollB, autoB, hideB = bottom:WaitForChild("RollButton"), bottom:WaitForChild("AutoButton"), bottom:WaitForChild("HideButton")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 90)
local FADED = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 92)

local function tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- MODES
--------------------------------------------------
local MODES = {
	full = {anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.78),
		aspect = 0.5, slot = 0.2, range = 3},
	mini = {anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.01), size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.27),
		aspect = 0.8, slot = 1 / 3.1, range = 1},
}
local minimized = false
local mode = MODES.full

local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
blur.Name = "RollBlur"
blur.Size = 0
blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function updateBackdrop(instant)
	local on = stage.Visible and not minimized
	local t = instant and 0 or 0.25
	tween(blur, t, {Size = on and 22 or 0})
	tween(dim, t, {BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.5 or 1})
end

local function applyMode()
	mode = minimized and MODES.mini or MODES.full
	stage.AnchorPoint = mode.anchor
	stage.Position = mode.pos
	stage.Size = mode.size
	aspect.AspectRatio = mode.aspect
	glow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot * 1.7)
	rays.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot * 2.6)
	for _, p in ipairs({pointerL, pointerR}) do p.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.14, mode.slot * 0.42) end
	updateBackdrop(true)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- REEL (7 recycled slots; slot for absolute index j = slots[j % 7])
--------------------------------------------------
local NSLOTS = 7
local slots = {}
local seq = {}

local function label(parent, props, st)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Font = FONT; l.TextScaled = true; l.TextColor3 = WHITE; l.BackgroundTransparency = 1; l.Text = ""
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Thickness = st; s.Color = BLACK; s.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round; s.Parent = l
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

for i = 1, NSLOTS do
	local cg = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
	cg.Name = "Slot" .. i
	cg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	cg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	cg.Visible = false
	local sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Parent = cg
	local odds = label(cg, {Name = "Odds", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.03), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), TextColor3 = GREEN}, 3)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "IconHolder"; holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5); holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48); holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.5)
	holder.Parent = cg
	local name = label(cg, {Name = "ItemName", Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.73), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.25)}, 4)
	cg.Parent = slotsFrame
	slots[i] = {cg = cg, scale = sc, odds = odds, holder = holder, name = name, item = nil, pop = 1}
end

-- visual filler items: common ones appear more often, like the real odds
local weightTotal = 0
for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do weightTotal += 1 / it.Chance end
local function randomItem()
	local n = math.random() * weightTotal
	for _, it in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		n -= 1 / it.Chance
		if n <= 0 then return it end
	end
	return Config.Items[1]
end
local function itemAt(j)
	if not seq[j] then seq[j] = randomItem() end
	return seq[j]
end

local function setItem(s, item)
	s.item = item
	s.odds.Text = "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance)
	s.name.Text = string.upper(item.Name)
	s.holder:ClearAllChildren()
	ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = s.holder
end

local posValue = Instance.new("NumberValue")
posValue.Value = 0
local lastPos, speed = 0, 0

local function render()
	local pos = posValue.Value
	local base = math.floor(pos + 0.5)
	local range = mode.range
	local used = {}
	local motion = math.clamp(speed / 35, 0, 1)
	for j = base - range, base + range do
		local s = slots[(j % NSLOTS) + 1]
		used[s] = true
		local item = itemAt(j)
		if s.item ~= item then setItem(s, item) end
		local d = j - pos
		local ad = math.abs(d)
		s.cg.Visible = true
		s.cg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, mode.slot)
		s.cg.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + d * mode.slot)
		-- fade + darken with distance, extra transparency when moving fast (motion blur feel)
		local fade = math.clamp(ad / (range + 0.5), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(fade * 0.92 + motion * (ad < 0.5 and 0.25 or 0.45), 0, 1)
		s.cg.GroupColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(FADED, math.clamp(ad * 1.2, 0, 1))
		s.scale.Scale = (1 - math.min(ad, 2) * 0.17) * s.pop
	end
	for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
		if not used[s] then s.cg.Visible = false end
	end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local p = posValue.Value
	speed = math.abs(p - lastPos) / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
	lastPos = p
	rays.Rotation = (rays.Rotation + dt * 20) % 360
	if stage.Visible then render() end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- ROLL
--------------------------------------------------
local rolling, rollId, lastFire = false, 0, 0
local waiting
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(result, counts, equipped, luck)
	if waiting then waiting(result, counts, equipped, luck) end
end)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local punching = false
local function fovPunch()
	if punching then return end
	punching = true
	local base = camera.FieldOfView
	tween(camera, 0.08, {FieldOfView = base - 6}).Completed:Wait()
	tween(camera, 0.35, {FieldOfView = base}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	punching = false
end

local function showStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", true)
	if not stage.Visible then
		stage.Visible = true
		render()
		updateBackdrop()
	end
end
local function hideStage()
	gui:SetAttribute("Rolling", false)
	stage.Visible = false
	updateBackdrop()
end

local function doRoll()
	if rolling or gui:GetAttribute("RebirthMenuOpen") then return end
	rolling = true
	rollId += 1
	local myId = rollId

	local animScale = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("RollAnimScale") or 1
	local gap = (Config.RollCooldown * animScale + 0.1) - (os.clock() - lastFire)
	if gap > 0 then task.wait(gap) end

	local result, counts, equipped, luck
	waiting = function(r, c, e, l) result, counts, equipped, luck = r, c, e, l end
	lastFire = os.clock()
	remote:FireServer()

	showStage()
	tween(rays, 0.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.55})
	tween(glowScale, 0.2, {Scale = 1})

	-- creep the reel while the server answers
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while result == nil and os.clock() - t0 < 3 do
		posValue.Value += 0.15
		task.wait()
	end
	waiting = nil
	if not result then
		rolling = false
		hideStage()
		return
	end

	local fast = gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	local base = math.floor(posValue.Value + 0.5)
	local dist = fast and 8 or (26 + math.random(0, 6))
	local target = base + dist
	for j = base + 1, target + 4 do seq[j] = randomItem() end
	seq[target] = Config.ByName[result] or Config.Items[1]
	for j in pairs(seq) do
		if j < base - 10 then seq[j] = nil end -- keep memory tiny
	end

	-- decelerate, overshoot a touch, settle back onto the winner
	local wonItem = Config.ByName[result]
	if Cutscene.ShouldPlay(wonItem, luck) then
		-- RARE: reel starts, then the screen cuts to black for the cutscene
		local tw = tween(posValue, 3.1, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		task.wait(0.9)
		Cutscene.Play(wonItem, luck)
		tw:Cancel()
		posValue.Value = target
	else
		tween(posValue, fast and 0.7 or 3.1 * animScale, {Value = target + 0.22}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint).Completed:Wait()
		tween(posValue, 0.35, {Value = target}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Wait()
	end

	-- winner!
	local win = slots[(target % NSLOTS) + 1]
	local popV = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	popV.Value = 1.3
	popV.Changed:Connect(function(v) win.pop = v end)
	win.pop = 1.3
	tween(popV, 0.4, {Value = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back).Completed:Connect(function() popV:Destroy(); win.pop = 1 end)
	glowScale.Scale = 1.5
	tween(glowScale, 0.5, {Scale = 1.2}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	rays.GroupTransparency = 0
	tween(rays, 1.2, {GroupTransparency = 0.3})
	if (Config.ByName[result] and Config.ByName[result].Chance or 0) >= Config.BigRollAt then
		task.spawn(fovPunch)
	end

	rollFinished:Fire(result, counts, equipped)
	rolling = false

	task.delay(1.8, function()
		if rollId == myId and not rolling then hideStage() end
	end)
end

local function bounce(btn)
	local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then return end
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.1}) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.88}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.25, {Scale = 1.1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
